# SkinCraft

> SkinCraft is a free 3D Minecraft skin editor. It runs directly in the web browser (no download) on Windows, Mac, Linux, Chromebook, Android and iPhone, and there is also a standalone Windows app. Users paint skins directly on a 3D player model and export a 64x64 PNG for Minecraft Java Edition or Bedrock Edition.

Key facts:
- Platforms: any modern web browser (desktop and mobile, touch controls, installable as a PWA and usable offline) at https://steth22.github.io/SkinCraft/app/ ; plus a standalone Windows 10/11 .exe.
- Price: free, no ads, no account.
- Made by Steth22 (copyright holder, all rights reserved), built with the help of Claude Code. Web app uses three.js; the Windows app wraps it with C# (.NET 9, WinForms + WebView2).
- Similar idea to mobile "3D skin editor" apps, available everywhere through the browser.

Features:
- Paint directly on the 3D model or on a flat 64x64 texture view
- Mirror mode (paint left and right sides together)
- Tools: pencil (1-3 px brush), eraser, fill (area / face / body part / whole layer), color picker, noise brush, shade/lighten
- Base layer, overlay (outer) layer, or both at once; hide individual body parts
- Classic (4px arms, Steve) and Slim (3px arms, Alex) models
- Pose previews: still, idle, walk, wave, zombie, dance
- Skin library with autosave, rename, duplicate, delete
- Import PNG skins (64x32 legacy skins are converted), drag and drop, and copy any Minecraft Java player's skin by username
- Shortcuts work with any keyboard layout; performance mode for slower PCs

- [Website](https://steth22.github.io/SkinCraft/): overview, screenshots, FAQ
